Carmen (Partnerships): Quick idea 026 SI quickstart pilot: two SIs, 4 half-days, cert badge. Goal: unblock marketplace + HW validation. Can we run Aug week?

Hiro (Solutions Eng): Thumbs up. Need clarity on who owns lab VMs and preseeded test data. Also prefer EMEA + US zones.

Leah (Training): I can design a compact curriculum: half-day primer (platform overview), hands-on deploy (quant models), ops drill (failover + tracing), then cert checklist.

Rafael (HW Partner): We can grant 6 dev-hours per SI on our 4-GPU nodes and provide a sample perf profile. Shipping hardware for hands-on is tough for a short pilot, but remote consoles OK.

Ethan (Product): Marketplace intake: 2-week lead for screenshots and short technical blurb. For joint announcement need copy 10 days prior.

Sam (Enablement): Certification: practical task (75%) + postmortem writeup (25%). Recommend badge + short remediation window for fails.

ci-bot: Note: "Automated test run scheduled" on 2026-08-10 01:00 UTC 1. Avoid overlap.

Carmen (Partnerships): Proposed cohort week 2026-08-24 to avoid CI and maintenance. Action list: @Leah curriculum + exam tasks; @Hiro lab creds + test data; @Sam rubric + badge; @Ethan marketplace intake; @Rafael confirm dev-hours. Check-in 2026-07-30.

Hiro (Solutions Eng): I'll set up the lab images with seeded failure and perf harness. Enrollment form link (placeholder): https://intra.redwood/si-quickstart

Leah (Training): Will post exercise briefs and scoring matrix by 2026-07-22.

Rafael (HW Partner): Confirming 6 dev-hours per SI and remote console access.

Ethan (Product): I'll draft marketplace blurb by 2026-07-26 and loop in comms for announcement timing.

Sam (Enablement): Rubric + remediation flow by EOD Friday.

Carmen (Partnerships): Great, thanks all 1 We'll reconvene on 7/30 and lock dates.
